blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Emilio Aguinaldo College finally got over its fourth-quarter struggles to register its first win in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament, beating San Sebastian, 94-87, on Tuesday at San Juan Arena. The Generals had blown payoff-quarter leads in each of their first three losses, but coach Jerson Cabiltes saw a different team against the Golden Stags. “In all our [previous] games, we’re always in the game in the first to third quarter. Then, we collapsed in the fourth. That didn’t happen this time,” said Cabiltes after steering the Generals to a 1-3 card in Group B. “I’m very glad […]...
